entries.meaning: （某一圈子里）热议的话题、谈资
entries.note: the talk of + 群体/圈子，表'成为…谈论的焦点'；写作可替换 widely discussed，语气更地道。
entries.quote: The decision of the New York Philharmonic to hire Alan Gilbert as its next music director has been the talk of the classical-music world ever since the sudden announcement of his appointment in 2009.
entries.quote_zh: 自 2009 年突然宣布这项任命以来，纽约爱乐乐团聘任 Alan Gilbert 出任下一任音乐总监的决定一直是古典音乐界热议的话题。

entries.note: 句首评性状语，等于 largely / by and large；比 mostly 更正式，写作中常用于先作整体判断再留例外。
entries.quote: For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least.
entries.quote_zh: 至少可以这样说，各方的反应大体上是正面的。

entries.note: A is no substitute for B 表'A 代替不了 B'；写作中表达'不可替代性'的高阶搭配。
entries.quote: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
entries.quote_zh: 那些回应说唱片替代不了现场演出的忠实音乐会观众，其实没有抓住要点。

entries.note: 态度词，常用于驳斥对方论证；反义表达为 drive / hit the point home。
entries.quote: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
entries.quote_zh: 那些回应说唱片替代不了现场演出的忠实音乐会观众，其实不得要领。

entries.note: stem from + 抽象原因，书面语替换 come from / result from；注意无被动、无进行式。
entries.quote: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
entries.quote_zh: 消费者如今作出购买决策的方式意味着，营销的影响力源自传统付费媒体之外的一系列广泛因素。

entries.note: in one's infancy 表'尚不成熟'，写作可描述新趋势、新技术、新制度。
entries.quote: This trend, which we believe is still in its infancy, effectively began with retailers and travel providers such as airlines and hotels and will no doubt go further.
entries.quote_zh: 我们认为这一趋势尚处起步阶段，它实际发端于零售商及航空、酒店等旅行服务商，无疑还将继续扩展。

entries.note: half A and half B 并列结构，表'两种性质兼而有之'；可迁移为 half praise and half warning 等。
entries.quote: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
entries.quote_zh: 那句低声细语，半是邀约、半是逼迫，正是多数人听到'同辈压力'一词时脑海里浮现的东西。

entries.note: take a page from sb.'s book 的缩略，2012 年真题解析明确点出的短语；写作提建议时高阶替换 learn from。
entries.quote: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
entries.quote_zh: Rosenberg 令人信服地主张，公共卫生倡导者应当向深谙运用同辈压力之道的广告商取经。

entries.note: exert + 抽象名词（influence / pressure / control）+ on，学术写作高频框架。
entries.quote: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
entries.quote_zh: 毫无疑问，我们的同辈群体会对我们的行为施加巨大影响。

entries.note: renege on a commitment / promise / deal，正式用语，多用于政企背信语境。
entries.quote: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the strict nuclear regulations.
entries.quote_zh: 这家新英格兰主要能源供应商上周宣布将违背长期遵守严格核监管规定的承诺，在佛蒙特州激起了合乎情理的公愤。

entries.note: abide by the rules / a commitment；与 comply with、adhere to 同族，介词 by 不可省略。
entries.quote: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the strict nuclear regulations.
entries.quote_zh: 这家新英格兰主要能源供应商上周宣布将违背长期遵守严格核监管规定的承诺，在佛蒙特州激起了合乎情理的公愤。

entries.note: be at odds with 表立场或事实相悖，写作替换 conflict with / be inconsistent with。
entries.quote: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
entries.quote_zh: 这种自上而下的时装业观念再过时不过，也与 Elizabeth Cline 历时三年写就的《过度装扮》中对'快时尚'的控诉所描绘的那个狂热世界格格不入。

entries.note: the past holds the key to the future；写作中引出解决思路的凝练表达。
entries.quote: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
entries.quote_zh: 一如常情，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：我们如今已辨识出塑造地球与人类历史的长时段规律，足以对后代将身处何种境况作出有据可依的预测。

entries.meaning: 不禁想、容易倾向于（得出某结论）
entries.note: be tempted to assume / conclude 常用于先立后驳的论证套路，暗含'该结论其实可疑'。
entries.quote: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
entries.quote_zh: 你甚至可能不禁认为，人类已没有什么未来值得期待。

entries.note: comply with ... to the letter 表'一字不差地遵守'，法律与规章语境高频。
entries.quote: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
entries.quote_zh: 白宫辩称，即便州法不折不扣地符合联邦法规，亚利桑那州的法律仍与其执法优先次序相冲突。

entries.note: bring sth. to bear on sth. 高阶书面搭配，写作可替换 apply ... to；bear 此处读 /beə/。
entries.quote: increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
entries.quote_zh: 增加对教师的投入，并鼓励学者把自身学识运用于应对当今的重大挑战。

entries.meaning: 抱怨的理由、投诉的依据
entries.note: grounds 复数表'理由、依据'；have grounds for + n./-ing，法律与议论文常用。
entries.quote: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
entries.quote_zh: 但几乎没有哪个地方，委托人会比在美国更有理由抱怨。

entries.note: a / the dearth of + 抽象名词（integrity / moral purpose），书面替换 lack of 且语气更强。
entries.quote: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions".
entries.quote_zh: 两年前，Rupert Murdoch 之女 Elisabeth 谈及'我们如此多机构中令人不安的诚信缺失'。

entries.meaning: 全盘接受、照单全收（不加辨别）
entries.note: swallow an argument / a claim whole 表'不加辨别地接受'，态度词，驳论写作可迁移。
entries.quote: But the justices should not swallow California's argument whole.
entries.quote_zh: 但大法官们不应把加州的说辞照单全收。

entries.meaning: 依据事情本身的是非曲直
entries.note: evaluate / judge a case on its merits 法律与评价语境高频；merits 复数僻义为'功过、是非'。
entries.quote: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.
entries.quote_zh: 总之，研究结论是：尽管检察官本应只依据案件本身的是非曲直断案，他们似乎确实会受到企业 CSR 记录的影响。

entries.note: impinge on / upon + 权益、健康，2016 年真题词义题考点；书面替换 harm / encroach on。
entries.quote: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
entries.quote_zh: 这些举措表明，美不应由最终会损害健康的外貌来定义。

entries.note: in the quest for + 抽象目标（profit / circulation / truth），书面替换 in pursuit of。
entries.quote: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
entries.quote_zh: 它的目的却是为了追求发行量与影响力而毁掉他人的人生。

entries.note: un- + pretentious（自负的）；2011 年词义题以 modest 作同义替换。
entries.quote: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him "an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him".
entries.quote_zh: 就连曾在《泰晤士报》撰文支持聘任 Gilbert 的 Tommasini，也称他为'一位不事张扬、毫无威严指挥家架子的音乐家'。

entries.note: 正式书面副词，常与完成时连用；替换 so far / until now。
entries.quote: As a description of the next music director of an orchestra that has hitherto been led by musicians like Gustav Mahler and Pierre Boulez, that seems likely to have struck at least some Times readers as faint praise.
entries.quote_zh: 对于一支迄今一直由 Gustav Mahler、Pierre Boulez 等音乐家执棒的乐团的下任总监而言，这样的描述至少会让部分《泰晤士报》读者觉得是明褒实贬。

entries.note: 及物动词，宾语常为 plans / accounts / records；名词 scrutiny 见 2012、2015 真题。
entries.quote: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
entries.quote_zh: 随着董事会迫于股东压力仔细审视继任计划，未获首肯的高管也可能萌生去意。

entries.note: 2011 年真题词义题考点（hunted for）；由'偷猎'引申为'挖角'，与 headhunter 同语义场。
entries.quote: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
entries.quote_zh: 多年来，高管与猎头都恪守一条规矩：最有吸引力的 CEO 人选必须是被'挖'来的。

entries.note: 兼含'挑衅'与'启发思考'两义；常修饰 story / claim / remark。
entries.quote: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, "I love My Children, I Hate My Life," is arousing much chatter.
entries.quote_zh: Jennifer Senior 那篇见解独到、颇具煽动性的杂志封面故事《我爱我的孩子，我恨我的生活》引发热议，并不令人意外。

entries.note: 抽象名词；instant / delayed gratification 是心理学高频搭配，与 moment-to-moment joy 形成对照。
entries.quote: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that "the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight".
entries.quote_zh: 尽管日复一日养育孩子可能令人心力交瘁，Senior 写道：'恰恰是当下扫兴的那些事，日后会成为强烈满足与欢愉的源泉。'

entries.meaning: 观察敏锐的、有洞察力的
entries.note: perceptive observer / remark；与 perspective（n. 视角）同源，注意区分。
entries.quote: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
entries.quote_zh: 这个想法看来颇有前景，而 Rosenberg 也是一位敏锐的观察者。

entries.note: glaring flaw / error / omission，表'明显到无法忽视'，多含贬义。
entries.quote: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
entries.quote_zh: 此处所呈现的'社会疗法'最显眼的缺陷，是它并不能长久奏效。

entries.meaning: 前科学、尚待验证的雏形发现
entries.note: proto-（原始、雏形）+ science；真题自造词，与 mature discovery 相对。
entries.quote: Consequently, discovery claims should be thought of as protoscience.
entries.quote_zh: 因此，发现声明应被视为尚处雏形阶段的'前科学'。

entries.note: collective scrutiny / additional scrutiny；2012 Text 3 与 2015 Text 3 两处真题复现。
entries.quote: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
entries.quote_zh: 但要让一项发现声明蜕变为成熟发现，需要集体审查与认可。

entries.meaning: 极其恶劣地、异乎寻常地（坏得出格）
entries.note: egregious 表'坏得出格'，副词常置于焦点成分附近；学术驳论态度词。
entries.quote: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most egregiously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
entries.quote_zh: 改革遭到强烈抵制，或许在教育领域最为突出——特许学校、学院与绩效工资都经历了旷日持久的争斗。

entries.note: 2013 年词义题考点（accusation）；由法律'起诉书'引申为'对…的严厉批判'。
entries.quote: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
entries.quote_zh: 这种自上而下的时装业观念再过时不过，也与 Elizabeth Cline 历时三年写就的《过度装扮》中对'快时尚'的控诉所描绘的那个狂热世界格格不入。

entries.note: see clothes as disposable；disposable income 则为'可支配收入'，义项随语境切换。
entries.quote: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable—meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that—and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
entries.quote_zh: 这些品牌怂恿讲究时髦的消费者把衣服看作一次性用品——只打算经得起一两次洗涤，尽管它们并不这样宣传——并每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。

entries.note: 英式拼写，美式常作 envision；envisage + n. / -ing / that 从句。
entries.quote: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
entries.quote_zh: 当今技术及其社会后果的潜在演化复杂得令人目眩，或许最好交给科幻作家与未来学家去探究我们所能设想的种种可能。

entries.note: 不可数名词；the prestige of the Nobels；注意词尾 -ge 发 /ʒ/。
entries.quote: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
entries.quote_zh: 老话说得好，格调买不来；这些暴发户企业家也无法为自己的奖项买来诺贝尔奖般的声望。

entries.meaning: 使长存、使（不良观念）延续固化
entries.note: perpetuate a myth / stereotype / inequality，多带贬义；与 perpetual 同源。
entries.quote: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research. They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research. They do not fund peer-reviewed research. They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
entries.quote_zh: 它们可能扭曲以成就为基础、由同行评审主导的研究体系；可能固化同行评审研究的现状；并不资助经同行评审的研究；还使'孤胆天才'的迷思长存。

entries.note: ir- + reproduce + -ibility；学术出版术语，与 reproducibility 相对。
entries.quote: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
entries.quote_zh: 在'数据分析中的基础性错误导致许多已发表研究结果无法复现'这一担忧广为扩散后，《科学》杂志跟随其他期刊推出了类似举措。

entries.note: 真题取'诚信'义，dearth of integrity 为全文题眼；与 data integrity（数据完整性）义项不同。
entries.quote: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
entries.quote_zh: 她认为，诚信之所以崩塌，是因为人们普遍接受'社会唯一的筛选机制应当是利润与市场'。

entries.note: 2016 年词义题考点（less severe）；lenient penalties / sentences。
entries.quote: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
entries.quote_zh: 研究发现，在被起诉的企业中，CSR 项目最完备者往往获得更宽大的处罚。

entries.meaning: 仲裁者、裁定者、权威判定者
entries.note: let others be arbiters of their beauty；arbiters of taste / elegance 属高阶抽象用法。
entries.quote: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
entries.quote_zh: 这些禁令若得到充分执行，将向女性（以及许多男性）表明：不应让别人来裁定自己的美。

entries.meaning: 处理、应对、设法解决（问题、疑虑）
entries.note: address doubts / a problem / the misuse of ...；2012 完形（address doubts about the court's legitimacy）与 2016 Text 1 两处真题复现，写作高频。
entries.common_meaning: n. 地址；v. 向…讲话、发表演讲
entries.rare_meaning: v. 处理、应对、设法解决（抽象问题）
entries.quote: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
entries.quote_zh: 依靠道德劝导而非法律来应对体型观念的误用，或许才是上策。

entries.note: make oneself subject to the code of conduct；subject to 是 2012 完形第 6 空答案，本句按研招网公布答案还原空格。
entries.rare_meaning: adj. 受…约束的（subject to）；v. 使遭受
entries.quote: At the very least, the court should make itself subject to the code of conduct that applies to the rest of the federal judiciary.
entries.quote_zh: 至少，最高法院应使自身受适用于联邦司法系统其他部门的行为准则约束。

entries.meaning: n. 法院、法庭（司法机构）；v. 谋求、招致（court criticism）
entries.note: 法政类阅读中 court 几乎总指法院 / 法庭；作动词时表「谋求、招致」，如 court controversy，是写作可用的中性表达。
entries.quote: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday—a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
entries.quote_zh: 最高法院周一以五比三的票数推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分条款——这是奥巴马政府一次不算大的政策胜利。

entries.note: an ethics code / the code of conduct；2012 完形原文，本句按研招网公布答案还原空格。
entries.common_meaning: n. 密码、编码、邮政编码
entries.rare_meaning: n. 行为准则、法典（ethics code / code of conduct）
entries.quote: Part of the problem is that the justices are not bound by an ethics code.
entries.quote_zh: 问题的部分症结在于，大法官们并不受伦理准则的约束。

entries.note: the social cure 中 cure 由医学「疗法」引申为社会问题的「对策、解决办法」；2012 英语一 Text 1、2019 英语二 Text 3 均考此义。
entries.common_meaning: v. 治愈（疾病）；n. 药物、疗法
entries.rare_meaning: n.（社会问题的）对策、解决办法（the social cure）
entries.quote: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
entries.quote_zh: 此处所呈现的'社会疗法'最显眼的缺陷，是它并不能长久奏效。

entries.meaning: 打破、颠覆（既有平衡、假定）
entries.note: upset the balance of power / upset the old assumption；2013、2015 两处真题均取动词僻义，非'使心烦'。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 心烦的、沮丧的；v. 使难过
entries.rare_meaning: v. 打乱、颠覆、推翻（平衡、假定、秩序）
entries.quote: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
entries.quote_zh: 但在更为重要的宪法问题上，这一判决以八比零挫败了政府试图打破联邦与州之间权力平衡的努力。

entries.meaning: （动词）出入社交场、与…往来酬酢
entries.note: wealthy families who party with the international 1%；名词转动词，真题中极易被误读作'政党'。
entries.common_meaning: n. 聚会；政党；（法律）当事人
entries.rare_meaning: v. 参加社交聚会、与…交际（party with sb.）
entries.quote: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
entries.quote_zh: 即便如此，这些仍是与国际顶层 1% 阶层往来酬酢的富裕家族，而媒体的无孔不入使其越来越难维持得体形象。

entries.note: Vanity is a constant 中作可数名词；2016 Text 2 的 constant guardianship 为形容词本义，可作义项对照。
entries.common_meaning: adj. 持续不断的、恒定的
entries.rare_meaning: n. 恒量、恒定不变的事物
entries.quote: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
entries.quote_zh: 虚荣心是恒常不变的；只有当人们负担不起'不这样做'时，才会开始更可持续地消费。

entries.note: sit for the bar / be called to the bar；2014 Text 2 法律职业主题高频词。
entries.rare_meaning: n. 律师界、律师职业；the bar 律师资格考试
entries.quote: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
entries.quote_zh: 另一项建议是，允许学生在法学院仅读两年后即参加律师资格考试。

entries.note: fashion state policies / fashion a solution；名词转动词，2013 Text 4 易被误读为'时尚'。
entries.quote: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
entries.quote_zh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定与现行联邦政策并行的本州政策。

entries.note: effect change 不等同 affect change；effect 作动词极正式，宾语多为 change / reform / a cure。
entries.quote: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment—including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line—Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
entries.quote_zh: 尽管数家快时尚公司已努力遏制其对劳工与环境的影响——包括 H&M 推出绿色'自觉系列'——Cline 认为，持久的改变唯有由消费者来促成。

entries.note: voice their opinions / concerns / objections；名词转动词，书面语替换 express。
entries.rare_meaning: v. 表达、吐露（意见、不满、担忧）
entries.quote: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
entries.quote_zh: 同样剧烈的技术变革在为营销者提供更多（且更多样）传播选择的同时，也加大了狂热消费者以更快、更显眼、更具杀伤力的方式表达意见的风险。

entries.note: 2015 Text 4 的 in newspapers, circulation 与 2016 Text 4 的 circulation lower 两处真题均指发行量。
entries.quote: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
entries.quote_zh: 被看重的词是效率、灵活性、股东价值、亲商、财富创造、销售、影响力，而在报业则是发行量。

entries.note: novel applications / a novel approach；形容词用法在科技与法律语境高频，勿与名词'小说'混淆。
entries.quote: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
entries.quote_zh: 新的颠覆性技术有时会要求对宪法的保护条款作出崭新的适用。

entries.note: frame the fact / the terms / the debate；学术写作中表'设定讨论框架'，另有'构陷'义。
entries.rare_meaning: v. 界定、框定；构陷、诬陷
entries.quote: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
entries.quote_zh: 在许多方面，道德宗旨的缺失不仅框定了如此普遍的电话窃听这一事实，也框定了审判得以展开的条件。

entries.note: A dwarfs B 表'规模上远超'，经济与数据对比语境高频；勿按名词'侏儒'理解。
entries.rare_meaning: v. 使显得微不足道、远超
entries.quote: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.
entries.quote_zh: 尽管纸质广告销售额仍远超其线上与移动端对应业务，来自纸媒的收入却仍在下滑。

entries.note: 2012 Text 1 主题词，2016 Text 1 以 rely more on peer pressure for enforcement 复现；心理与行为域核心术语。
entries.quote: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
entries.quote_zh: 这是同辈压力的一种微妙形式：我们会无意识地模仿每天所见的行为。

entries.meaning: 赢得型媒体（消费者自发推荐形成的口碑传播）
entries.note: 与 paid / owned / sold / hijacked media 共同构成 2011 Text 3 的营销媒介术语矩阵。
entries.quote: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
entries.quote_zh: 对某产品满怀热情的消费者可能通过自愿向朋友推荐而创造'赢得型'媒体，企业则可借向网站注册用户发送产品与促销邮件提醒来运营'自有型'媒体。

entries.note: challenge the constitutionality of ...；法律与治理域高阶抽象名词。
entries.quote: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
entries.quote_zh: 相反，这家公司恰恰做了它长期承诺不会做的事——在联邦法院挑战佛蒙特州规则的合宪性，以此孤注一掷地维持其佛蒙特扬基核电站的运转。

entries.note: 2012 完形 the court's legitimacy 与 2014 Text 3 Time ... has given them legitimacy 两处真题复现；本句按研招网公布答案还原空格。
entries.quote: The court cannot maintain its legitimacy as guardian of the rule of law when justices behave like politicians.
entries.quote_zh: 当大法官们表现得像政客时，最高法院便无法维系其作为法治守护者的合法性。

entries.note: contested provisions / the provisions of a law；复数僻义，勿按'供应品'理解。
entries.quote: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
entries.quote_zh: 在'亚利桑那州诉美国'案中，多数派推翻了亚利桑那州那项饱受争议的计划中四项受质疑条款里的三项——该计划意在让州与地方警察执行联邦移民法。

entries.note: search ... without a warrant / while a warrant is pending；2015 Text 2 宪法第四修正案语境核心术语。
entries.quote: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
entries.quote_zh: 最高法院如今将审议：逮捕时若手机在嫌疑人身上或近旁，警方能否在无搜查令的情况下查看手机内容。

entries.meaning: 可信化过程（个人发现经学界检验转为公认发现）
entries.note: 2012 Text 3 主题术语；与 discovery claim、collective scrutiny、protoscience 构成科学发现语义场。
entries.quote: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.
entries.quote_zh: 这就是可信化过程：经由它，研究者个人的'我、此处、此刻'转化为学界的'任何人、任何地、任何时'。

entries.note: 2014 Text 3 的 peer-review-led research 与 2015 Text 3 的 peer-review process 两处真题复现；学术出版核心机制。
entries.quote: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
entries.quote_zh: 《科学》杂志主编 Marcia McNutt 今日宣布，该刊将在同行评审流程中增设一轮统计核查。

entries.note: 2013 Text 1 的 advocates of sustainability 与 2016 Text 2 的 sustainable development 同根复现；环境与能源域核心词。
entries.quote: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
entries.quote_zh: 她表现出许多可持续性倡导者共有的理想主义，无论是在食物还是能源领域。

entries.note: 2016 Text 3 主题词；与 shareholder value、halo effect、monetary value 构成商业伦理语义场。
entries.quote: But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.
entries.quote_zh: 但即便你接受 Friedman 的前提，把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为浪费股东的钱，事情也未必全然泾渭分明。

entries.note: 2011 Text 2 职场与就业域术语；与 CEO turnover、headhunter、poach 同语义场。
entries.quote: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
entries.quote_zh: 随着董事会迫于股东压力仔细审视继任计划，未获首肯的高管也可能萌生去意。

entries.note: 2015 Text 1 主题词；与 abdicate、royals、aristocratic、republican 构成政体语义场。
entries.quote: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
entries.quote_zh: 那么，西班牙的危机是否预示着君主制正走向末日？
